79535-life-of-a-licensed-victualler-s-da.title: Life Of A Licensed Victualler S Daughter
79535-life-of-a-licensed-victualler-s-da.creator: Unknown
79535-life-of-a-licensed-victualler-s-da.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. My father, Joseph Ashford, was the son of a barber and wig-maker, of the same name, in a small market town in Shropshire, who, having a large family, employed his boys, as soon as they were able, in his own business. My father, as I have heard him say, by a tragi-comic sort of affair, became a different trade.

arxiv-2103-02773.title: Transcritical Bifurcations and Algebraic Aspects of Quadratic Multiparametric Families
arxiv-2103-02773.creator: Jorge Rodríguez Contreras, Alberto Reyes Linero, Bladimir Blanco Montes, Primitivo B. Acosta-Humánez
arxiv-2103-02773.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jorge Rodríguez Contreras, Alberto Reyes Linero, Bladimir Blanco Montes, Primitivo B. Acosta-Humánez. This article reveals an analysis of the quadratic systems that hold multiparametric families therefore, in the first instance the quadratic systems are identified and classified in order to facilitate their study and then the stability of the critical points in the finite plane, its bifurcations, stable manifold and lastly, the stability of the critical points in the infinite plane, afterwards the phase portraits resulting from the analysis of these families are graphed.

arxiv-2105-09095.title: Aleatoric uncertainty for Errors-in-Variables models in deep regression
arxiv-2105-09095.creator: J. Martin, C. Elster
arxiv-2105-09095.description: Abstract A Bayesian treatment of deep learning allows for the computation of uncertainties associated with the predictions of deep neural networks. We show how the concept of Errors-in-Variables can be used in Bayesian deep regression to also account for the uncertainty associated with the input of the employed neural network.

arxiv-2310-12411.title: Online Multi-IMU Calibration Using Visual-Inertial Odometry
arxiv-2310-12411.creator: Jacob Hartzer, Srikanth Saripalli
arxiv-2310-12411.description: Abstract This work presents a centralized multi-IMU filter framework with online intrinsic and extrinsic calibration for unsynchronized inertial measurement units that is robust against changes in calibration parameters. The novel EKF -based method estimates the positional and rotational offsets of the system of sensors as well as their intrinsic biases without the use of rigid body geometric constraints.

arxiv-2409-18382.title: CurricuLLM: Automatic Task Curricula Design for Learning Complex Robot Skills using Large Language Models
arxiv-2409-18382.creator: Kanghyun Ryu, Qiayuan Liao, Zhongyu Li, Payam Delgosha, Koushil Sreenath, Negar Mehr
arxiv-2409-18382.description: Abstract Curriculum learning is a training mechanism in reinforcement learning (RL) that facilitates the achievement of complex policies by progressively increasing the task difficulty during training. However, designing effective curricula for a specific task often requires extensive domain knowledge and human intervention, which limits its applicability across various domains.

arxiv-2411-01480.title: Strong F F -regularity and the Uniform Symbolic Topology Property Thanks: Polstra was supported in part by NSF Grant DMS #2101890
arxiv-2411-01480.creator: Thomas Polstra
arxiv-2411-01480.description: Abstract . We investigate the containment problem of symbolic and ordinary powers of ideals in a commutative Noetherian domain R R . Let R R be a normal domain of prime characteristic p > 0 p>0 that is F F -finite or essentially of finite type over an excellent local ring.

arxiv-2505-06205.title: Derivations and Hochschild cohomology of quantum nilpotent algebras
arxiv-2505-06205.creator: Stéphane Launois, Samuel A. Lopes, Isaac Oppong
arxiv-2505-06205.description: Abstract We compute the derivations of Quantum Nilpotent Algebras under a technical (but necessary) assumption on the center. As a consequence, we give an explicit description of the first Hochschild cohomology group of U q + ​ ( 𝔤 ) U_{q}^{+}(\mathfrak{g}) , the positive part of the quantized enveloping algebra of a finite-dimensional complex simple Lie algebra 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} .

arxiv-2508-00026.title: Cosmological Reconstructions in Einstein–Cartan–Myrzakulov Gravity with Torsion and Non-Metricity in the Weitzenböck Geometrical Sector
arxiv-2508-00026.creator: Davood Momeni, Ratbay Myrzakulov
arxiv-2508-00026.description: Abstract The universe is a vast and complex system, and our understanding of its fundamental workings is constantly evolving. In this work, we present a novel modification to the standard theory of gravity by incorporating curvature, torsion, non-metricity, and the geometric structure of Weitzenböck spacetime.

arxiv-2509-20919.title: Efficient Kernelized Learning in Polyhedral Games Beyond Full-Information: From Colonel Blotto to Congestion Games
arxiv-2509-20919.creator: Andreas Kontogiannis *, Vasilis Pollatos *, Gabriele Farina, Panayotis Mertikopoulos, Ioannis Panageas
arxiv-2509-20919.description: Abstract We examine the problem of efficiently learning coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in polyhedral games , that is, normal-form games with an exponentially large number of actions per player and an underlying combinatorial structure. Prominent examples of such games are the classical Colonel Blotto and congestion games.

arxiv-2602-10721.title: The range of once-reinforced random walk on the half-line
arxiv-2602-10721.creator: Zechun Hu, Ting Ma, Renming Song, Li Wang
arxiv-2602-10721.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zechun Hu, Ting Ma, Renming Song, Li Wang. In this paper, we consider a once-reinforced random walk on the half-line, and give the limiting behaviors of all the moments of its range. Keywords: once-reinforced random walk; range process; half-line.

britannica-1911-spinal-cord.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-spinal-cord.description: Article 'Spinal Cord' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 25), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. ac sm lh100|(From Gray’s Anatomy, Descriptive and Surgical.) ac|Fig. 1.—Transverse Section of the Spinal Cord and its Membranes. } SPINAL CORD, in anatomy, that part of the central nervous system in man which lies in the spinal canal formed by the vertebrae, and reaches from the foramen magnum to the lower margin of the first lumbar vertebra.

pmc-11345213.title: Quantitative proteomic analysis and replacement therapy identifies haptoglobin as a therapeutic target in a murine model of SLE-associated diffuse alveolar hemorrhage
pmc-11345213.creator: Ninghui Yan, Chenyi Shao, Yan Zhen, Xueliang Zhang, Nana Xia, Qiang Guo
pmc-11345213.description: BackgroundDiffuse alveolar hemorrhage (DAH) is a catastrophic clinical syndrome and one of the manifestations of pulmonary involvement in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), which is characterized by hemoptysis, diffuse pulmonary infiltrates, and respiratory failure. However, the treatment options for DAH remain limited, and DAH-related studies are needed to explore more effective therapeutic directions for better disease management and improved prognosis.

pmc-11493008.title: Important functions and molecular mechanisms of aquaporins family on respiratory diseases: potential translational values
pmc-11493008.creator: Jinshan Li, Dongyong Yang, Lanlan Lin, Liying Yu, Luyang Chen, Kaiqiang Lu, Jieli Lan, Yiming Zeng, Yuan Xu
pmc-11493008.description: Aquaporins (AQPs) are a subgroup of small transmembrane transporters that are distributed in various types of tissues, including the lung, kidney, heart and central nervous system. It is evident that respiratory diseases represent a significant global health concern, with a considerable number of deaths occurring worldwide.

pmc-11631507.title: The white gene as a transgenesis marker for the cricket Gryllus bimaculatus
pmc-11631507.creator: Emmanuel Gonzalez-Sqalli, Matthieu Caron, Benjamin Loppin, M Arbeitman
pmc-11631507.description: The cricket Gryllus bimaculatus is an emerging model insect of the order Orthoptera that is used in a wide variety of biological research themes. This hemimetabolous species appears highly complementary to Drosophila and other well-established holometabolous models. To improve transgenesis applications in G. bimaculatus, we have designed a transformation marker gene inspired from the widespread Drosophila mini-white+.

pmc-12472262.title: Human Herpesvirus 6 Activates NF-κB Signalling and CD163-Positive Macrophage Recruitment in Alcohol-Induced Hepatic Injury
pmc-12472262.creator: Anda Upane, Simons Svirskis, Valerija Groma, Sandra Skuja
pmc-12472262.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Human herpesvirus 6 (HHV-6) establishes lifelong latency in immune cells and may contribute to the progression of ethanol-induced liver injury. To elucidate the contribution of HHV-6 to alcohol-induced hepatic injury, this study evaluated HHV-6 protein expression, NF-κB signalling, and CD163-positive macrophage recruitment in liver samples from control subjects, young individuals with recent alcohol exposure, and individuals with long-term chronic alcohol use.

pmc-12502114.title: Optimizing hemodialysis management using bioelectrical impedance analysis: emphasizing the significance of the phase angle
pmc-12502114.creator: Jungho Shin, Hongtae Kim, Hae Eun Jeon, Soie Kwon, Jin Ho Hwang, Hyung-Eun Son, Semin Cho, Jeong Min Cho, Su Hyun Kim
pmc-12502114.description: Patients undergoing hemodialysis (HD) often experience complications, such as severe malnutrition, muscle wasting, and fluid overload, which significantly affect survival rates and quality of life. Accurate assessment and management of nutritional status and fluid retention are essential for improving patient outcomes.

pmc-12609943.title: Association of IL-18 and CXCL10 Levels with Disease Severity in Vietnamese Patients with Dengue Infection
pmc-12609943.creator: Long Hoang Tran, Cuong Duy Do, Phuong Minh Nguyen, Ben Huu Nguyen, Linh Tung Nguyen, Cuong Xuan Hoang, Minh Duc Chu, Su Xuan Hoang, Kim Oren Gradel
pmc-12609943.description: Objectives: to investigate the association of IL-18 and CXCL10 levels with disease severity in Vietnamese patients infected with Dengue virus. Methods: A total of 295 serum samples were collected from patients with clinical presentation of Dengue virus infection during the 2022–2023 outbreaks in Hanoi, Vietnam. Clinical and laboratory parameters were recorded at the time of admission.

pmc-12753752.title: Magnetically modified amino MXene psyllium hydrogel nanobiosorbent for the simultaneous removal of hexavalent chromium and curcumin from wastewater
pmc-12753752.creator: Magda E Abouelanwar, Mohamed E Mahmoud
pmc-12753752.description: Chromium, particularly Cr(VI), is a highly toxic contaminant that poses serious health risks, including immune system suppression and damage to the liver and kidneys. Its widespread presence in industrial wastewater, along with the recent detection of organic pollutants such as curcumin, raises growing environmental concerns.

pmc-12979435.title: Altered attention and visuospatial abnormalities in Parkinson's disease: links to attention networks and basal ganglia
pmc-12979435.creator: Jian Song, Yanyan Li, Yuqing Zhao, Haoping Gu, Jinfeng Xu, Xianling Xu, Wei Wei, Xiehua Xue
pmc-12979435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAttentional and visuospatial deficits in Parkinson's disease (PD) are linked to disrupted attention networks (AN), yet specific neural mechanisms remain unclear. This study aims to elucidate the relationship between these dysfunctions and aberrant AN circuits in PD.MethodsSixty-two PD patients stratified by cognitive status [cognitively normal (PDCN), mild cognitive impairment (PDMCI), and dementia (PDD)] and 53 matched healthy controls (HC) underwent resting state functional MRI. We performed amplitude of low-frequency fluctuation (ALFF) and seed-based functional connectivity (FC) analyses.

pmc-13264374.title: Combination therapy with moderate-intensity statins and ezetimibe and risk of incident PCI/CABG in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: a propensity-matched cohort study
pmc-13264374.creator: Haonan He, Junhan Tang, Vincent Ka Chun Yan, Joseph Edgar Blais, Chun-Ka Wong, Mark Tsz Kin Tam, Hei Hang Edmund Yiu, Hung-Fat Tse, Esther Wai Yin Chan
pmc-13264374.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryBackgroundCombination therapy with moderate-intensity statins and ezetimibe has demonstrated advantages over high-intensity statin monotherapy for several cardiovascular outcomes. However, its effect on the risk of incident percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) and coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) remains unclear.

pmc-13301347.title: Pulse Field Ablation using the circular multielectrode array catheter and variable-loop circular catheter: First comparison data in a Real-World Prospective Study
pmc-13301347.creator: T Chiba, V Tscholl, C Benachi, P Formum, P Wienke, P Nagel, J Lucas, M Huemer, U Landmesser, N Dagres, F Hohendanner, G Hindricks, R Haettasch, P Attanasio
pmc-13301347.description: BackgroundPulsed field ablation (PFA) is an innovative, non-thermal ablation technology for the treatment of atrial fibrillation (AF). Although several PFA technologies are now available, real-world and comparative data on their safety and efficacy remain limited. This study aimed to compare outcomes between the circular multielectrode array catheter (CMAC) and the variable-loop circular catheter (VLCC) in a real-world cohort.

pmc-13461674.title: Predication of ICU Length of Stay and External Validation in a Tertiary Level ICU Using Artificial Intelligence (AI) Prediction Model
pmc-13461674.creator: Sohini Roy, Pradeep Rangappa, Karthik Rao, Sabyasachi Sensarma
pmc-13461674.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThe length of stay (LOS) of a patient in (ICU) is a process measure of ICU efficiency that is commonly used as an indicator of ICU performance.1 While premature early release from the ICU might result in medical issues and an increased risk of readmission to the ICU or even greater mortality, longer stays in the ICU are linked to higher care costs and resource utilization.2 Accurate prediction of intensive care unit (ICU) length of stay (LOS) is crucial for resource planning.

uslaw-usc-t25-s1833.title: 25 U.S.C. § 1833 — Use of funds
uslaw-usc-t25-s1833.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s1833.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 20 (Tribally Controlled Colleges And Universities Assistance); Subchapter II (Tribally Controlled College Or University Endowment Program). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Interest deposited, pursuant to section 1832(b)(2)(C) of this title, in the trust fund of any tribally controlled college or university may be periodically withdrawn and used, at the discretion of such college or university.
